current_norm_gate: Full Academic Guide under V. V. Lopatin: sentence-end punctuation; dash in incomplete/connecting functions; homogeneous members; repeated members; joining constructions; interjections/particles; affirmative/negative/question-exclamatory words
normalization_rule: Count mastery decisions, not source paragraphs. Merge cross-domain repetition punctuation/orthography when the learner must classify the same surface construction before choosing comma/dash/no mark versus a lexical hyphen.

P01_sentence_end.canonical_label: Конец предложения и прерывание речи: точка, вопросительный, восклицательный знак, многоточие и допустимые сочетания
P01_sentence_end.current_norm_scope: One structured terminal-punctuation engine: communicative type, emotional/question intonation, incompleteness/interruption and combinations such as ?! or !.. where norm permits.

P02_dash_incomplete.canonical_label: Тире в неполном и эллиптическом предложении
P02_dash_incomplete.current_norm_scope: Dash marks a structurally recoverable omitted member / parallel ellipsis or a pause in defined elliptical constructions; absence of a pause or different structure may remove the dash.
P02_dash_incomplete.ownership_boundary: Does not replace the subject–predicate dash identities already active.

P03_intonational_dash.current_norm_scope: Owns the deliberate intonational/logical break where syntax alone does not create one of the already separately owned mandatory dash constructions. Variation is part of the decision, not a false absolute rule.

P04_connecting_dash.canonical_label: Соединительное тире: пределы, маршруты и смысл «от — до»
P04_connecting_dash.current_norm_scope: Owns the connecting dash between words/numerals denoting spatial, temporal, quantitative and analogous limits or endpoints; distinguish a dash from a hyphen inside one lexical unit.

P05_homogeneous_no_conjunction.canonical_label: Однородные члены без союзов: запятая, точка с запятой или тире по структуре и интонации
P05_homogeneous_no_conjunction.current_norm_scope: Base comma for intonationally enumerated homogeneous members plus structured branches for semicolon with internally complex groups and dash for contrast/emphatic relation; fixed semantic wholes are excluded by prior classification.

P06_homogeneous_appositions.canonical_label: Однородные или неоднородные приложения: классификация и запятая
P06_homogeneous_appositions.current_norm_scope: Classify appositions by whether they characterize the same referent in a homogeneous enumeration or form a hierarchically/nonhomogeneously related naming chain; punctuation follows classification.
P06_homogeneous_appositions.ownership_boundary: Does not absorb school-apposition-basic-isolation-boundaries or school-apposition-hyphen-boundary: those answer different apposition questions.

P07_homogeneous_single_conjunction.canonical_label: Однородные члены с неповторяющимся союзом: запятая или отсутствие запятой
P07_homogeneous_single_conjunction.current_norm_scope: Single connecting И/ДА=И normally joins homogeneous members without comma; adversative А/НО/ДА=НО and joining/additive uses require their source-established punctuation; classify the function before applying the sign.
P07_homogeneous_single_conjunction.deferred_joint_absorption: school-single-i-homogeneous-vs-clause-boundary is not absorbed yet because it also owns the simple-vs-compound-clause side; reevaluate jointly under Wave F P13 SSP base.

P08_P09_repetition_boundary.canonical_label: Повтор слов: синтаксический повтор со знаками препинания или единое повторное сочетание через дефис
branches: enumerative/emphatic syntactic repetition with comma or context-dependent dash
one predicate with repeated verb joined by И and no comma in the defined whole-predicate pattern
lexical/intensifying repetition forming one hyphenated complex: синий-синий, еле-еле, кто-кто etc.
special repeated-word constructions routed by current norm rather than punctuation by visual repetition alone
P08_P09_repetition_boundary.historical_cross_links: Former adverb-specific repeat cards remain historical/provenance branches already absorbed in Wave C; they are not reactivated here.

P10_joining_constructions.canonical_label: Присоединительные конструкции: отделение добавочного сообщения запятой, тире или другим допустимым знаком
branches: strength of attachment and intonation controls comma vs stronger boundary where current norm permits

P11_interjection_particle_punctuation.canonical_label: Междометие или омонимичная частица: обособлять или не обособлять
P11_interjection_particle_punctuation.decision_model: First establish interjectional independent emotional function versus particle/function-word use; an interjection is separated by comma or stronger sign according to intonation, while the homonymous particle is not isolated merely by surface form.

P12_yes_no_question_exclamatory.canonical_label: ДА / НЕТ и вопросительно-восклицательные слова: запятая, конечный знак или отсутствие отделения по функции
branches: да/нет as affirmative/negative words inside a sentence
да/нет as independent utterances with ! ? . … according to intonation
what/how/well-like question-exclamatory words before a following explanatory utterance vs ordinary sentence member/particle use

count_assertion.warning: 168 is not final. Complex-sentence Wave F and direct-speech/citation Wave G remain open; both are expected to absorb existing narrow cards.

Jointly resolve school-single-i-homogeneous-vs-clause-boundary and existing SSP/BSP special units.
